record.explanation: The target occurrence 王敦 appears in Liu Xiaobiao's annotation (sfh1-ev-36-chouxi-003-liu-annotation-001), within the phrase '也為中宗相州刺史路過武昌王敦'. This is a reference to Wang Dun (王敦), the famous Eastern Jin general and rebel who killed Sima Cheng (司馬丞), Prince of Qiao. The main text of the entry (sfh1-ev-36-chouxi-003-main) also mentions 王敦 at the same narrative point, where the mother of Wuji states '王敦昔肆酷汝父' (Wang Dun once cruelly killed your father). The annotation context confirms this is the historical figure Wang Dun, the general who rebelled against the Jin court and had Sima Cheng killed. The referent is the historical person Wang Dun (王敦), courtesy name Chuzhong (處仲), the generalissimo (大將軍) of the Jin dynasty.
